A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VirSci research. The text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting and relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original baseline comparisons, human evaluations, collaboration experiments, and component ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds a temporal data-leakage experiment in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The five-stage procedure, collaborator sampling, retrieval, invitation mechanism, novelty voting, and abstract refinement remain unchanged. Self-review details move from Section 3.2 to Appendix B.1 without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Appendix A adds evaluation against OAG 3.2 papers from 2024–2025, representing research beyond the model's stated training cutoff. This extends temporal test coverage while retaining the existing computer-science and cross-domain tasks.

E2.justification: HypoGen and AI Scientist remain the evaluated baselines in Table 1. The comparator sets in the retained component, discussion-pattern, exploration, and underlying-model experiments are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The new temporal-isolation experiment retains 2010–2020 past papers and uses 30,000 papers from 2024–2025 as the contemporary reference database, with four LLaMA3.1-8b agents and one to seven turns. Existing baseline protocols, metrics, and dataset filtering settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v3 supplements the leakage discussion with a quantitative comparison of contemporary reference periods in Appendix A, Table 2. The existing ablations and robustness analyses are retained, with v2 Section 5 relocated to Appendix D.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging experimental results over 20 runs. Metric validation retains three LLM evaluations and three independent human ratings per abstract; no new uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing practice is introduced.

E6.justification: New Table 2 reports temporal-comparison results, including ON values of 3.40 with 2021–2023 references and 3.35 with 2024–2025 references at five turns. These are different evaluation conditions, not a v2-to-v3 performance decline. Table 1 and the matched prior ablation and figure results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The prompt equations, collaborator-selection probabilities, exploration distribution, and ON definition are retained. Moving self-review equations to Appendix B.1 adds no new mathematical reasoning or formal results.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of a realistic scientific ecosystem, an inter- and intra-team collaboration pipeline, improved idea novelty, and collaboration patterns consistent with Science of Science findings.

C2.justification: v2 primarily discusses limitations in simulating concurrent teams. v3 substantially expands this to research-domain and community biases, misleading scientific claims, high-stakes applicability, plagiarism, privacy, and human oversight. Appendix A also adds an interpretation of the temporal-isolation results as evidence against substantial leakage effects.

D1.justification: Appendix A supplies an OAG 3.2 access reference and documents the new experiment's corpus size, dates, model, team size, and normalization. Existing code access, hardware, runtime, embedding model, filtering instructions, and prompts are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds Ansar and Talavera (2025) on bias testing and Zhao et al. (2023) on watermarking. Earlier cited works and the central research positioning are retained, with limited clarification of the criticism of synthetic scientist profiles and collaboration networks.

P1.justification: The document is substantially reorganized: the ablation study moves to Appendix D, self-review details to Appendix B, and cross-dataset consistency discussion to Appendix G. Discussions becomes expanded Limitations and Ethics Statement sections, although most retained scientific prose changes little.

P2.justification: The manuscript changes from a narrow single-column layout to a two-column article, extensively resizing and regrouping retained figures and tables. Ablation displays move into the appendix, several table headers expand, and the temporal-comparison Table 2 is added; the existing figure graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 adds quantitative temporal-isolation evidence where v2 lacked that check, and gives more explicit limitations concerning bias, unreliable scientific claims, and misuse. These are useful but bounded gains: the new experiment covers one model and team size and does not establish that baseline rankings are unaffected by leakage. The core method and established results remain unchanged.
